morgan-mgr: Hey team — quick Q: I'm prepping a promotion packet and want to confirm preferred evidence format so reviewers don't ask for clarifications. Any do/don't tips?

violet-hr: Short answer: keep it structured + metric-first. Do: 3-5 concise bullets, each with a metric or customer quote when possible. Don't: long prose or pasted meeting notes.

morgan-mgr: Good — examples of a clean bullet?

sam-comp: Use this micro-pattern: Action (past tense) + Frequency/Timeframe + Outcome (metric or stakeholder result). e.g., "Led DB migration (Q1Q2), reduced P99 latency by 45% and cut incident rate by 60%."

morgan-mgr: Nice. What about artifacts? PR links, slide decks — include or attach?

violet-hr: Attach links for large artifacts. But always include a 1-line summary in the evidence field so reviewers don't have to click everything. If it's behind an internal repo, ensure perms or export a short pdf.

morgan-mgr: How many peer calibrations are expected?

sam-comp: Standard is 2 anonymized peer notes. If the candidate worked cross-functionally, add one partner note (PM/EngOps) to show breadth. Keep each note to 1-2 lines.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: required fields in form: employee_id, manager, current_level, requested_level, evidence, comp_rationale, effective_date, backpay_yes_no. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/leveling-comp-change

morgan-mgr: Timeline Q: comp committee meeting cadence and payroll cutoffs?

payroll-bot: Next comp committee: 1935002400 UTC. Payroll cutoff for that committees retro pay is 1935001800 UTC. Packets submitted after cutoff get reviewed next cycle.

violet-hr: If you're cutting close, mark the packet "time-sensitive" and include the business reason; we can try to fast-track but it's not guaranteed. Also, appeals are allowed within 14 days if new evidence appears.

morgan-mgr: Helpful. One weird edge-case: candidate has private customer emails with praise — can we include them?

violet-hr: Yes, but redact PII and confidential clauses. Legal signs off faster on redacted snippets. Prefer a 1-line quoted snippet plus a link to redacted doc.

morgan-mgr: Anything else that commonly trips reviewers?

sam-comp: Two things: 1) avoid requesting an exact salary without a band/percentile — committee prefers band + percentile. 2) If requesting >15% or equity refresh, include exec sponsor and funding note.

morgan-mgr: Great — I'll assemble with the micro-pattern bullets, attach one demo link with summary, and ping when submitted. Thanks!
